name: DataSpace
tagline: An Access-style database studio running natively in the browser
summary: DataSpace is a modular database studio with an Office-style ribbon, editable datasheets, graphical queries, form design, report previews and relationship diagrams. The browser build is the actual Uno/Skia application compiled to WebAssembly, backed by a managed SQL engine with subqueries, crosstabs and transactional undo — all split into five independently reusable libraries.

highlights.title: Office-style workspace
highlights.text: Ribbon, quick-access commands, File backstage, searchable object navigation and tabbed objects in one shell.

highlights.title: Skia-drawn datasheets
highlights.text: Visible-cell drawing with lazy row materialization, range selection, TSV clipboard, sorting, filtering and cached totals.

highlights.title: Visual query design
highlights.text: A native QBE grid with draggable source cards, join properties and criteria rows that round-trips SELECT SQL.

highlights.title: Real SQL engine
highlights.text: Managed parser and executor with hash joins, UNION, correlated subqueries, TRANSFORM/PIVOT crosstabs and SELECT INTO.

highlights.title: Forms and reports
highlights.text: Bound record-entry forms with snapped drag/resize design, plus paginated report previews with Skia PDF export.

highlights.title: Transactional undo
highlights.text: Every edit is validated and published as one atomic, undoable revision; failed edits leave the live document untouched.

highlights.title: Safe browser storage
highlights.text: Transactional IndexedDB saves with cross-tab version checks, so a conflicting tab fails instead of silently overwriting.

highlights.title: Reusable libraries
highlights.text: Core, Query, Storage, Rendering and Controls ship as separate packages; the engine runs without Uno at all.

items: Ribbon with quick-access commands and a File backstage
Searchable object navigation with tabbed objects
Record navigation and explicit error reporting
Northwind-style demonstration workspace on first launch
Typed fields with required, default, primary and unique constraints
Detached field design and ordered single/composite index editing
Visible-cell Skia drawing with lazy row materialization
Range selection, keyboard navigation, native text editing and TSV clipboard
Sorting, resizing, filtering, debounced search and cached totals
Design View, SQL View and Datasheet View for every query
Native QBE grid with draggable source cards, joins, criteria and OR rows
Crosstab Builder with fixed column headings and row totals
Find Duplicates and Find Unmatched builders that generate ordinary SQL
Parameter editing and read-only result grids
Streaming SELECT/TOP with bounded ordered TOP selection
INNER/LEFT/CROSS joins with transient equality hash joins
UNION/UNION ALL, GROUP BY/HAVING and saved queries as sources
Correlated scalar, EXISTS, IN, ANY/SOME and ALL subqueries
Atomic INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, SELECT INTO and constraint-index DDL
TRANSFORM/PIVOT crosstab execution
Bound text and Yes/No controls with record navigation
Snapped control drag/resize, creation, deletion and property sheet
Reports from table or query sources with title, orientation and field selection
Pagination, zoom and Skia PDF export through the same page renderer
Referential checks and cascades
Draggable relationship diagrams
Explicitly invoked, ordered workspace macro actions; imported macros never auto-run
Versioned .dspace JSON documents
CSV import and export via External Data → Text File
Transactional IndexedDB with cross-tab version conflict detection
Explicit .dspace backup exports and desktop file adapters

packages.name: DataSpace.Core
packages.role: Typed document model, validation, relational constraints, transactions, history, snapshots and document codec

packages.name: DataSpace.Query
packages.role: Managed SQL parser, expression evaluation, relational execution, QBE/Find/crosstab models and lazy table views

packages.name: DataSpace.Storage
packages.role: CSV interchange, versioned optimistic persistence contracts and asynchronous save sessions

packages.name: DataSpace.Rendering
packages.role: UI-independent Skia datasheet, form, relationship, report and icon renderers

packages.name: DataSpace.Controls
packages.role: Office-style Uno ribbon, navigation, datasheet, object designers, query builders and optional workspace shell

codeSamples.title: Engine usage without Uno
Embed the workspace
Build and run
codeSamples.code:
git clone https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/DataSpace.git
cd DataSpace
dotnet workload install wasm-tools

dotnet test tests/DataSpace.Tests/DataSpace.Tests.csproj -c Release
dotnet run --project src/DataSpace.App/DataSpace.App.csproj -f net10.0-desktop

# Publish the real browser application
dotnet publish src/DataSpace.App/DataSpace.App.csproj \
  -c Release -f net10.0-browserwasm -o artifacts/publish
python3 scripts/stage-site.py
python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory artifacts/site

shortcuts.action: Commit the active editor and save locally

playground.intro: The live build opens a Northwind-style demonstration database you can browse, query and edit entirely in the browser.

tour.title: Explore the sample database
tour.text: Use the searchable object navigation to open tables in tabs, then sort, filter and search a datasheet.

tour.title: Edit and undo
tour.text: Edit cells directly in a datasheet, copy a range as TSV, and step back through changes with undo.

tour.title: Design a query
tour.text: Open a query and switch between Design View, SQL View and Datasheet View to see the QBE grid round-trip SQL.

tour.title: Build a crosstab
tour.text: Choose Crosstab Builder, pick row headings, a column heading and an aggregate, then Generate SQL and Run.

tour.title: Find duplicates
tour.text: Use Find Duplicates or Find Unmatched in the query editor to generate a saved SQL query from a table and keys.

tour.title: Import and save
tour.text: Import a CSV via External Data → Text File, press Ctrl+S to save to IndexedDB, and export a .dspace backup.

architecture.name: Model
architecture.text: Owns the typed document, validation, copy-on-write transactions, undo history and snapshots.

architecture.name: Query and storage
architecture.text: A managed SQL engine and visual design models, plus CSV and optimistic versioned persistence, all built on Core.

architecture.name: Rendering
architecture.text: SkiaSharp renderers for datasheets, forms, relationships, reports and icons that depend on Core but not Uno.

architecture.name: Controls
architecture.text: Independently usable Uno ribbon, datasheet, designers and query builders, plus an optional full workspace shell.

boundaries: Not a Microsoft Access replacement: native .accdb/.mdb, ACE/Jet and VBA are not supported
Browser storage is local, unencrypted and scoped to the origin/profile — export .dspace backups
Derived FROM subqueries, RIGHT/FULL joins and updatable joined queries are not implemented
Reports lack group sections, subreports, charts and conditional formatting; forms lack subforms and events
Query execution is synchronous in the browser; indexes are constraint metadata, not persistent B-trees
